# Vendored Agent Skill Files
# ============================================================
# Third-party skill reference material vendored verbatim into .agents/skills/.
#
# Read by script/skills-sync and .github/workflows/skills-sync.yml.
#
# Why vendor instead of installing the upstream skill:
#   The upstream skill is monolithic — installing it also brings dashboards,
#   AppDaemon, helper selection, and scene guidance that this collection has no
#   use for. More importantly, its own SKILL.md tells agents to prefer the Home
#   Assistant config API and UI helpers over writing YAML, which is the exact
#   opposite of what a blueprint collection does. Vendoring takes the reference
#   material without the framing; the wrapper SKILL.md next to each vendored
#   file states the overrides.
#
# Rules for vendored files:
#   - NEVER edit them here. They must stay byte-identical to the pinned ref,
#     and `script/skills-sync --check` fails otherwise. Corrections belong
#     upstream; local commentary belongs in the wrapper SKILL.md.
#   - They are excluded from Prettier and markdownlint for the same reason
#     (see .prettierignore and .markdownlint-cli2.jsonc).
#   - Every source repository needs its LICENSE vendored alongside.
#
# Updating:
#   script/skills-sync --update      # move the pin to upstream HEAD and pull
#   script/skills-sync --check       # verify local copies match the pin
#
# The scheduled workflow runs --update and opens a pull request, so an upstream
# change is reviewed here before it lands.
#
# Format:
#   UPSTREAM <owner/repo or URL>     Source repository for the entries below
#   REF <commit>                     Pinned commit (full SHA — not a branch)
#   <upstream path> -> <local path>  One file mapping per line
#
# initialize.sh removes the scheduled sync workflow, because a blueprint author's
# own repository receives the vendored files through template-sync from THIS
# repository rather than tracking the third-party upstream itself. This manifest
# and script/skills-sync are kept there: --check still verifies the vendored
# files, and a plain run restores one that was edited by accident.
# ============================================================

# ── homeassistant-ai/skills (MIT) ────────────────────────────
# Home Assistant automation building blocks: native triggers and conditions
# (including the 2026.7 purpose-specific family), wait actions, automation
# modes, variables, repeat/choose, trigger IDs. Actively maintained and quick to
# track Home Assistant release changes — which is precisely the material this
# collection does not want to own itself.
UPSTREAM homeassistant-ai/skills
REF 9e4eff281112218953dc708687d24601777f9ccb

LICENSE -> .agents/skills/ha-automation-patterns/vendor/LICENSE
skills/home-assistant-best-practices/references/automation-patterns.md -> .agents/skills/ha-automation-patterns/vendor/automation-patterns.md
